locale_code.description: Not translated: the language code of this catalog (BCP 47), for the lang attribute.

locale_dir.description: Not translated: the writing direction of this catalog, ltr or rtl.

extension_name.description: The brand. Keep it in Latin letters in every language.

extension_description.message: Removes most of the background music from YouTube™ videos and keeps the voices. Everything runs on your computer.
extension_description.description: Store summary and extensions-page description. 132 characters at most.

control_name.description: Name and tooltip of the player button while the music plays; a click removes it. Like YouTube's "Mute", it says what a click does.

control_on.description: Name and tooltip of the player button while Musicless removes the music; a click brings the music back. Like YouTube's "Unmute", it says what a click does, with the same verb as "Remove music".

control_setup.description: Tooltip and name of the player button before the first run (the note with a small dot); it opens the page that turns Musicless on.

control_failed.description: Tooltip and name of the player button after a failure (the note with a small dot); a click reopens the choice.

notice_working.description: Under the spinner in the middle of the video while it waits a moment for the first audio without music (at the start, or after a jump).

notice_done.description: Said once by screen readers when a wait ends and the video plays without its music.

notice_blocked.description: Name, read by screen readers, of the round play button in the middle of the video when the browser needs a click before it plays sound.

panel_title.description: Title of the failure dialog; the reason follows it.

panel_original.description: Plays the video with its original audio, music included. Must be unmistakable.

failure_protected.description: Copy-protected: the owner locked the video, as rented movies are.

failure_codec.message: This video’s sound format isn’t supported.

failure_missed.message: Reload the page to remove the music from this video.
failure_missed.description: Under the title “Musicless is on” (done_heading), on a video that was already playing when the user turned Musicless on: its sound went by unread, and a reload is all it needs. The main button is “Reload page”.

failure_uncaptured.message: Reloading the page usually fixes this.
failure_uncaptured.description: Musicless could not find this player’s sound (it may play in a part of the page Musicless cannot read).

failure_source.message: This player’s sound can’t be reached.

failure_slow.message: It’s taking too long. Your computer may be busy.

failure_engine.message: Reloading the page usually fixes this.

failure_audio.message: The sound didn’t start. Reloading the page usually fixes this.

failure_updated.message: Musicless was updated or turned off. Reload the page to continue.

setup_heading.description: Heading of the first-run page: what the user gets.

consent_text.message: To remove most of the music, Musicless reads the sound of the YouTube videos you play, on this computer only. It never uploads or saves the sound. Its setting may sync through Chrome Sync.
consent_text.description: The disclosure before Musicless reads any audio (first-run page and popup); the privacy policy link follows it. Keep every fact: reads the videos' sound, on this computer only, never uploaded or saved, its setting may sync through Chrome Sync.

consent_accept.description: The one button of the disclosure: the user's consent.

done_heading.description: First-run page after the choice. Also the title of the dialog on a video that was already playing when the user turned Musicless on (failure_missed).

done_wait.message: Each video waits a few seconds as it starts, while the music is removed.
done_wait.description: First-run page after the choice: prepares the user for the pause at every video's start.

done_control.message: To play one with its music, use {icon} in the player.
done_control.description: First-run page after the choice. {icon} is replaced by the player button's struck note; keep it, wherever the sentence needs it.

done_text.message: If a YouTube tab was already open, reload it.
done_text.description: Musicless cannot reach tabs opened before it was turned on; most users have none, so the condition comes first. On the first-run page, and under the popup's switch right after it is turned on there.

done_open.description: Button: opens youtube.com in this tab.

done_back.description: Button instead of “Open YouTube” when the page was opened from a video’s button: goes back to that tab and reloads it where the video was, so its music can be removed.

popup_autostart_label.description: The one switch in the toolbar popup. Before the first run, turning it on is the consent, with the disclosure under it.

popup_one_video.message: To remove the music from one video, use {icon} in the player.
popup_one_video.description: Under the popup's switch, only while it is off. {icon} is replaced by the player button's note; keep it.

link_help.description: Link to the help: how Musicless works and what to do; reporting a problem is one link further.

link_help_url.description: Not translated: the address of the help in this language (README's "Using Musicless"; docs/help.ar.md for Arabic).
